steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Ah.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Aye.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: That would be our bridge.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: What's left of her.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: It's on the map, right enough. Bridge, river, road east.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Look at the saplings coming up through the roadbed. At least five years' growing since it fell. Mayhap more.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Five years... They sent us out with a map five years stale.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: It's a crown bridge, Fen. Word of it likely never reached the right desk, is all.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: You said that about the milestone. And the waystation. And the chapel with the tree growing out of it.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: And when we reach the post, they'll hear about all four.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Here. Look at this.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Going upstream... that'll be the way around, then.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Boot-worn, and deep. Plenty have walked it before us.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: So then. An unmarked path through strange country, or three days back to that village with the cute barmaiden.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: We've only food enough for two days.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: The path it is... If I'm eaten, I expect a proper funeral. Cooked meats. Weeping. Someone reads a poem.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: You'll get a hole and a hat on a stick.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: You're a good friend, {player_name}. I mean to note it in my will, which I shall begin drafting the moment—

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Do not try the pilings.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Stars above — a living soul. Madam, we had nearly resolved to swim it.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: A carter tried that last autumn. He lives; his cart is still down there.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Six years gone, the river folk say. The path serves instead — it crosses at a shallows half a day up. I have walked it these two years.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Six. You were close.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Fenwick. My friend is {player_name}.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Well met.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Elara. I trade the villages out here. Pots, salt, needles, news.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Where are you two bound? There is little east of here but trees.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: The old outpost, if it still stands. They tell us it stands.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: The outpost.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: You know it?

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: I know its turn in the road. Two years trading this circuit, and I have watched folk come out of that country, usually families with everything they own on a mule. Once, a man carrying his own front door. You would be the first I have seen walking in.

options.text: You're wondering why we'd head there.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: I am wondering what is worth the walk. Nobody has paid me to carry goods that way in two years. Now the crown sends men.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: The relief for its garrison, in fact. All of it, I'm afraid.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Are you. Where are the rest of you?

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: There are no others. We two are the whole of it.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: My own road runs east as well.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: The roads have been bad this year. Wolves, trolls, and whispers of worse. Two soldiers make for welcome company.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Glad to have you, then.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: All the way to the gate, if you allow it. Two years on this road, and I have never once seen inside those walls. I would like to know what I have been passing.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Settled, then. And take heart, madam. Whatever else this road does to us, I ensure we eat well.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Let us make haste. It is half a day to the ford, and the light will not wait.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Supper on the far bank, then. What grows out here that's worth a pot?

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: Come, and I will tell you.
